articles.title: Trump's Magic Words: How 'Complete and Total Endorsement' Changes the Game
articles.summary: President Trump is handing out his 'Complete and Total Endorsement' earlier than ever—sometimes a full year before Election Day. That gives his favorite Republican candidates a huge head start, and most of them win easily.

articles.title: A Grandpa's Second Chance: Why a Supreme Court Ruling Could Send Him Back to Prison
articles.summary: Anthony Bailey, 61, is a bus driver and grandpa who got out of prison early after 27 years. But now, a Supreme Court ruling on 'compassionate release' could force him to go back—maybe until he's 86.

articles.title: A 250-Year-Old Mystery Solved: DNA Finds a Revolutionary War Soldier's Family
articles.summary: Scientists used DNA to identify a soldier who died in the Battle of Camden in 1780. His name was John Pumphrey, and they found his living relatives—like 71-year-old Nancy White, who never knew she had a Revolutionary War hero in her family tree.
